description: Check whether recent changes require rebuilding the app before testing, without starting a build. Reports the reasons and any checks that could not be completed.

bundleId.description: Exact installed bundle/package to inspect; defaults to the project identifier.

platform.description: Defaults to the active Ceraph platform.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

scheme.description: iOS scheme to compare with the last successful build.

variant.description: Android variant to compare with the last successful build.

name: rn_check_prebuild
